name: SVR Poker Android

realDeviceValidation.target: Verify SIT moves the camera to the table edge, turn and bet indicators remain readable, showdown identifies the winner and winning cards, and ANTE UP starts the next hand.
changes: Corrects the actual Android camera world position after SIT and RECENTER
Shows the active player, current bet, amount to call, and last action
Shows all six players' current hand bets and most recent actions
Shows winner, settled pot, winning hand name, winner hole cards, and board
Shows an immediate ANTE UP / NEXT HAND prompt after showdown
Preserves the Phase 356 freeze recovery and Phase 347 single controller

updateMessage: An optional SVR Poker Android update is available.
updateMenuPolicy: Hidden unless releaseReady is true, apkUrl is non-empty, and apkVersionCode is newer than the installed code.
notes: Phase 357 changes the remotely loaded Android web runtime and does not require reinstalling APK 0.1.0-rc1.
The owner reported that SIT did not move the view close enough and that turn, bet, winner, winning-hand, and next-hand information was missing.
Phase 357 measures the camera in world space and moves the rig by the exact camera-to-seat delta.
The authoritative Phase 336 state remains the source for turns, bets, pots, winners, cards, and hand labels.
The showdown prompt uses the phrase ANTE UP while accurately stating that the next hand is a $10 / $20 blind hand.
APK version name 0.1.0-rc1, version code 1, manual-update-only, forceUpdate false, and showUpdatePrompt false remain locked.
